bayts.text: And whoever has served me or visited, save him and forgive him his sins.
And whoever has loved me or inclined toward me, grant him guidance and wealth.
And whoever has insulted or blamed me, grant him repentance and submission.
And whoever has thought ill of me, turn his heart in my favour, O my Lord.
And spare me the harm of all the worlds, and spare them (my) harm, O Lord, Āmīn.
And make my building a building of well-being, that draws me toward pure good things.
And make my building a building of knowledge, and of acting by the Sunna, and of forbearance.
And make my building a building of right guidance, and keep from me the plotting of every aggressor.
And spare me forever the harm of Satan and his party, the oppressors in the lands.
And keep from me every person who does not seek Your Countenance: turn him away swiftly when he comes.
And swiftly turn away all that corrupts from my hand and from my house, wherever it appears.
And bring what sets right into my hand and into my house, and make it firm through the Guide, the Faithful.
And raise me, and raise whoever helps me, and spare me all that abases me.
And keep my dwelling safe from the wicked, and favour the people with flowing water.
And make it, Lord, hastened favours (here) drawing deferred favours (hereafter).
O Living (Al-Ḥayy), O Self-Subsisting (Al-Qayyūm), be the One Who answers me: You are the Answerer, the Generous, the Watchful (Ar-Raqīb).
To You alone I have fled from all other than You (cf. Qurʾān 51:50): so be for that my leader to Your guidance.
And be for me Lord, Protector and Helper, and for all the Muslims, O All-Seeing (Al-Baṣīr).
And multiply the good things of this land and its provision, and spare it misfortune.
And establish in it a community that performs the five prayers constantly, O Wise (Al-Ḥakīm).
And save us from the evil of this age and the evil of others, and from every trial.
And spare us the evil of the Christians and the Jews, and the evil of Iblīs and of every denier,
of the jinn, the Antichrist (ad-Dajjāl), the Blacks, in the East and the West, and the Bīḍān (Moors),
and from the evil of all that is on earth and in the sky, of the manifest and the inward that has hidden itself.
O Subtle, O Generous, O Majestic: deal with all of us with Your beautiful kindness.
And lead all of us to salvation and success, and grant us success in what is right and in righteousness.
And make us eager to do what You have loved, and spare us doing what You have hated.
And never try any of us with what he cannot bear, O Eternal Refuge (Aṣ-Ṣamad).
And grant us ease and success in both Abodes, and achievement,
by the standing of this day and the standing of him who was born on it: we sought his like and did not find (it),
Muḥammad, the most excellent of Allah's creatures, without hesitation or doubt.
Upon him bless forever with the best blessing, by which we accompany the chosen and the trustworthy.
And grant us to take what he brought us and to leave what he forbade us to do (cf. Qurʾān 59:7),
until each of us is, in movements and in stillnesses, a follower of the Sunna.
And save us, by his standing, from false claims, and keep lying and idle play away from us.
And spare us passion and what does not concern us, and through You make us always free of need, O Enricher (Al-Mughnī).
O Allah, Your hoped-for forgiveness is vaster than the terrifying sins of a disobedient one.
O Kind, Your mercy is more hoped-for by us than any deed we earn: so forgive us,
and (forgive) all the Muslims together, and the Muslim women all, at every moment.
And do not take us to task for ill manners, and for audacity and much play.
For truly we, even if we have dared, hope in none but You: be for us, out of grace.
And do not take us to task for much excess, outwardly and inwardly, and for heedlessness.
And be our refuge from pestilence and from all that descends from the sky,
and from all that circles on the earth and what is between them, O Lord of the sky.
And draw our hearts, with our limbs, toward piety and the fear of Allah, by the standing of the sincere Counsellor.
And bless with the purest blessing, that repels pestilence from us (and) guards against locusts,
him and the Family, with the most excellent peace, and his Companions; and encompass my dwelling, O Peace (As-Salām).
And purify my soul and increase me in knowledge (Qurʾān 20:114), that lifts worry from me in the two Abodes.
And purify my heart and increase me in modesty, and make me live in obedience, O my Lord.
And make my right hand like a cloud in generosity, blessed in hardship and in ease.
O Allah, O Bestower, O Highest Companion: make me travel today the most profitable road,
by the sanctity of the accepted Intercessor, the Brought-Near, of the Family, the Companions and the month of Rajab.
Bestow on me precedence and truthful affirmation, by the sanctity of the Foremost, the Truthful (Abū Bakr aṣ-Ṣiddīq).
And bestow on me truth and enabling grace, by the sanctity of the Enabled, the Discerner (ʿUmar al-Fārūq).
And grant me the felicity of the two Abodes, by the right of ʿUthmān, possessor of the two Lights (Dhū n-Nūrayn).
Then, by the sanctity of our Imam ʿAlī, grant me in the two Abodes a renown that rises high.
O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Lord: accept our verses,
by the sanctity of al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn, together with the sanctity of everyone who joined the Companions.
